name: graph
description: The graph maths layer (ADR 0023): the neutral GraphNode and GraphEdge shape Diagram and Network take, and pure, deterministic functions over it — a layered (Sugiyama-style) layout, a tidy tree, a radial tree, a seeded and incremental force layout with pinned nodes, adjacency, hop distances and breadth-first shortest paths, edge geometry that lands the arrow tip on a node's frame (box) or 26px from its centre (circle), and the pan-and-zoom maths: fit, zoom about a point, the least pan that keeps a box in view, and nearest-node-in-a-direction for arrow keys. Our own code, no dependencies: dagre, d3-hierarchy and d3-force were the plan's candidates and stay behind check:boundaries should a consumer need what these do not do.
